steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Opiro, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model from the published survey:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 54.639 | 0.2147 | 0.2147
2 | 9147.8 | 0.30305 | 0.51774
3 | 1119.9 | 21.107 | 21.625
4 | 2566.8 | - | -

The paper labels this station's curve as KH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Opiro, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the paper's curve-type label does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note — Station Opiro, Etche LGA (VES interpretation)**

The four-layer model begins with a thin, low-resistivity topsoil (54.6 ohm-m, 0.21 m), most likely moist lateritic/clayey cover. This is underlain by a very thin but extremely resistive second layer (9147.8 ohm-m, 0.30 m), interpreted as dry, compacted or indurated sand/laterite hardpan. The third layer (1119.9 ohm-m) is the main unit, 21.1 m thick, extending to 21.6 m depth — a dry to partially saturated sand. The fourth layer (2566.8 ohm-m) is undelimited at depth and again highly resistive, suggesting coarse sand/gravel.

Curve-type check: 54.6 < 9147.8 > 1119.9 gives K; 9147.8 > 1119.9 < 2566.8 gives H. The curve is therefore **KH-type**, consistent with the published label.

Drilling note: resistivities remain high throughout; no clear low-resistivity saturated horizon is resolved within 21.6 m. Drill deeper and log continuously before setting screens.
